item.title: Episode 2 | Your Juniors Look Better With AI — But Are They?
item.description: Episode 2 | Your Juniors Look Better With AI — But Are They? Juniors using AI produce better work — but their craft doesn't improve once the AI is gone. A three-month MIT field experiment with 133 patent lawyers found the opposite of what you'd expect: juniors gain most with AI and least without it, while seniors gain most without it. This episode unpacks the experiment, the springboard-vs-cushion split, and three things managers can do on Monday: two scorecards, mandatory hands-on steps for juniors, and a different job for seniors. Adapted from the column article 'Does AI Assistance Enhance or Erode Expertise?' (article 112), source MIT, David Autor et al., Oct 7, 2026. Hosts: Xiaose and Marcus. Duration 12:46.

item.title: Episode 1 | 40% deploy AI, 6% profit from it
item.description: Episode 1 | 40% deploy AI, 6% profit from it. Forty percent of large companies have deployed AI agents at scale — only six percent say AI contributes more than five percent of operating profit. The gap isn't technology; it's how the company is run. This episode unpacks McKinsey's AI operating system: what it is, its four jobs, a global insurer's three-day turnaround, four differences from traditional tools, six priorities for building one, and four shifts in management itself. Ends with three things you can do on Monday. Adapted from the column article 'AI Operating System: The CEO's New Way of Running the Company' (article 111), source McKinsey, Oct 12, 2026. Hosts: Xiaose and Marcus. Duration 14:14.
